description: Events at the venues of the hotels of Corissia Resorts (festive meals, Christmas, New Year's Eve, brunch, music nights), as published on corissia.com: date and time, venue, hotel, title and summary, status, menu, price, booking, terms (cancellation, minimum age) and the page of the event. Sorted by start. Without from and to: the events that are not over; with them: the events on those days, from the start to the end of each (a réveillon also on 1 January). Times in Greek time (ISO 8601). status: announced, menu_published, full (the venue takes requests for its waiting list) or past. A series (repeat: the days of the week and its last day) is one event, at its next time, or at its first time on the days asked. booking: the request form of the venue (url), open, waitlist, deposit; the venue team confirms each request, and the connector books nothing. price: per person in EUR with what it includes, or null; menu: the menu section of the venue, or menu_note when the menu is not published yet. url: the page of the event on corissia.com. API v3.

hotel.description: Only the events of this hotel.

kind.description: Only this kind: festive_meal, reveillon, brunch, music_night or other.

lang.description: Language of the texts: en, de or el (Greek); default en.

venue.description: Only the events of this venue.
